purpose: Restore invalidated KADID baselines under globally shared reference-group cross-validation before constructing a forgetting-factor bank.

projection.qualification: post-mean-pooling capacity baseline; not patch-level nonlinear aggregation and not full RanPAC

bootstrap.qualification: post-selection empirical paired bootstrap; not selection-adjusted and not a formal coverage guarantee

test_policy: development-only descriptive evaluation after training-only group-CV selection
notes: One reference id has one fold across all distortion families.
Every training reference is out-of-fold exactly once.
All hyperparameters and methods are selected from training-side OOF loss only.
The repeatedly inspected KADID test split is development evidence, not independent confirmation.
The image-level projection restores the invalidated v1 capacity baseline but does not implement patch-before-pooling nonlinearity.
